# Pull Request

## Context
Why is this change needed?

## Authority
List the governing files, decisions, ADRs, contracts, or research evidence.

## Scope
What is changed? What is explicitly not changed?

## Evidence status
Use one or more where relevant:
- VERIFIED
- DERIVED
- HYPOTHESIS
- PROJECT_ASSUMPTION
- UNKNOWN
- CONTRACT_VERIFIED

## Validation
Describe tests, simulations, replay evidence, schema checks, or manual verification.

## Architecture impact
- [ ] No architecture change
- [ ] Architecture change is covered by an ADR / decision record

## Safety / control impact
- [ ] No safety-critical behavior changed
- [ ] Safety Kernel / command arbitration impact reviewed

## Compatibility
Describe contract, data, deployment, and migration impact.

## Checklist
- [ ] Read docs/00-authority/handoff/CURRENT.md
- [ ] Read relevant Authority
- [ ] No silent contract break
- [ ] No silent weakening of tenant/security/safety boundaries
- [ ] Validation evidence attached or referenced
